data.completion_memo: Implemented complete immutable managed-local build slots behind narrow artifact-read and anchored storage ports. Added bounded manifest/path/media validation, streamed SHA-256 whole-bundle verification and materialization, atomic immutable publication, ownership/volume/no-follow revalidation, and candidate/active/previous-known-good role fencing that retains rollback until verified.
data.description: Implement helper-controlled active, candidate, and previous-known-good whole-bundle slots with content-addressed manifests, anchored no-follow handles, ownership and same-volume verification, atomic publication, preserved rollback content, and exact revalidation before launch. Read only the baton-named staged build artifact and never compile or update the helper during activation.
data.title: M11.3 — Implement immutable managed-local build slots
